name: Streetwear Volume

intent_defaults.description: A streetwear-oriented starting point with relaxed proportions, layered styling and user-selected graphic or detail placement.
intent_defaults.silhouette: Relaxed to oversized, with adjustable volume and proportion controls.

component_defaults.volume: User-adjustable shoulder, body and sleeve volume
component_defaults.graphics: Optional user-owned or rights-cleared graphic placements

accessibility_defaults: All fit, closure, coverage and material choices remain user-editable.
circularity_defaults: Offer repair, alteration and modular-replacement options where compatible with the wearer intent.
caveats: Oversized proportions are a visual direction, not a universal fit recommendation.
Graphic references must be user-owned, licensed or otherwise rights-cleared.
